semantic_evidence.selected_root_replay: Every candidate t is replayed against the selected alpha/beta/t root triple. This rejects foreign conjugates, source poles, points outside the finite chord, and non-incidences before publishing a contact.
semantic_evidence.contact_evidence: Accepted contacts retain the exact source parameter, exact algebraic image point, exact chord-local parameter/order evidence, and exact tangent-cross sign. Tangencies remain contacts with zero tangent cross rather than being silently discarded.
semantic_evidence.adjacent_endpoint_ownership: General non-adjacent scheduling retains a legitimate authored-endpoint contact. The adjacent fallback explicitly excludes only its known shared authored parameter, preventing duplicate topology events without guessing field identity.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: STRICT accepts only exact polynomial elimination, isolating intervals, certified signs, selected-root replay, and exact topology. Any unproved or positive-dimensional case remains an explicit blocker.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph. Hypercurve observes every approximate certainty from Hypersolve; only the shared terminal may decide an equality at 512 bits, and returned geometry remains hyperreal::Real evidence.
